newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Foster's sees core profits improving.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Foster's sees core profits improving.

text.p: Foster's Brewing Group Ltd said on Monday the underlying operating performance of the company had improved considerably improved in 1995/96 and it expected this to continue in the immediate future.

"In the coming two or three years, this process will be driven further ... operating profit from CUB, Mildara Blass and China will be driven higher," Foster's chief executive Ted Kunkel told the annual meeting.
Kunkel made the remark in forecasting continued improvement in operating performance of its core businesses over the next two to three years.
He also committed Foster's to pursuing any investment opportunities which enhanced shareholder value, as part of the group's strategy to position itself for long-term growth.

But he suggested internal sources of cash were deep, citing A$400 million worth of proceeds from Foster's asset sale programme yet to be freed up, cash flow from its 40-percent owned Canadian brewer, Molson Breweries, and higher returns from its half-owned British pub chain, Inntrepreneur Pub Co Ltd.
